title: Eastern Idaho Town Hall Phone Bank (7/1)
description:
Please join us for a virtual phone bank ahead of our Eastern Idaho town halls! On July 1st, we’ll be meeting at 5:30pm MT via Zoom to make phone calls to community members to invite them to upcoming town halls.

During the 2025 legislative session, Idaho lawmakers passed House Bill 93 and enacted a $50 million school-voucher program. For the first time in state history, Idaho tax dollars will be used to subsidize the cost of tuition for private-school families.

The special-interest groups promoting vouchers have made clear that the $50 million program is only the beginning. During next year’s legislative session, they intend to remove the $50-million cap and expand the program to all private-school families, including the wealthy, at an estimated cost of $339 million per year.

Such a massive expansion of vouchers would bankrupt Idaho and drain millions from public schools. For the benefit of a small number of private-school families, it would defund the public education system that serves 94% of Idaho’s kids.

It may be inevitable that the legislature tries to expand House Bill 93, but it is not inevitable that they will succeed. To stop this attack on public schools, we need to get organized. Please sign up if you can make it and we hope to see you soon!

title: The United Vision Project Training - How to Have Authentic Relational Conversations (July 2025)

sponsor.name: The United Vision Project & National Training Hub

description:
America may never have been this divided, and we can either take action or watch our country fracture even more. Watch this to learn more - [It's Gonna Be OK Corral](https://youtu.be/orSWXzrsVcA?si=KdjKSH3yTpeZ4vPd)

Many of us are grieving the growing distance between loved ones, neighbors, and communities as our country becomes more divided, and more dangerous for more of us. If you’ve ever wondered how to bridge those gaps—or how your personal relationships connect to something larger—this training is for you. In a time of deep division, how can we show up with curiosity, empathy, and skill—especially when it’s hardest? This interactive training introduces United Vision Project’s *Authentic Relational Conversations* (ARC) framework, a transformative approach rooted in personal growth and collective impact.

In this training, we’ll explore how everyday conversations can become powerful tools for healing and change. You’ll learn why hard conversations feel so charged, how the brain reacts to disagreement, and how empathy and curiosity can help shift even the most difficult dynamics. Together, we’ll practice core skills like active listening, de-escalation, and conversational receptiveness that can mend relationships and open up space for genuine connection.

More than just interpersonal repair, this training is part of a larger movement to rebuild trust and resilience in our communities and create the future that we want and need—by strengthening relationships, one conversation at a time.

At this training we will:

- ​​Explore the personal and political importance of engaging across difference

- Learn how empathy and curiosity can shift the dynamics of hard conversations

- Understand the neuroscience behind polarization and why disagreement can feel so threatening

- Practice active listening, conversational receptiveness, and de-escalation in real-time scenarios

- Connect personal growth to a larger strategy for building relationships and organizing across political and cultural divides

San Pablo, CA — a small, working-class city just 2.6 square miles wide, located on unceded Ohlone territory — is being turned into a regional hub for militarized policing.

If this complex is being built to serve the entire region for the next 30 years, then people across city lines — and across generations — deserve a say. title: Action Item: The Big Ugly Bill
description:
Please call about this terrible, horrible, no good, very bad bill!!

The Senate is scheduled to vote on this bill the last week of June. Trump, the shell game grifter in chief, is doing EVERYTHING he can to focus your attention elsewhere. Don’t let your attention follow the shiny object while the GOP destroys our economy and health care system. They ARE planning on bleeding both Medicaid and Medicare to fund a MASSIVE tax break for the uber-wealthy.

The Congressional Budget Office estimates that 14 million Americans will lose healthcare provided by Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act, if this budget is passed. The Center for Budget and Policy Priorities reports that 261,000 Wisconsinites will lose healthcare from a single provision in the budget—work requirements—alone! Medicaid takes care of one-third of the children in Wisconsin, one in three people with disabilities, and 400,000 Wisconsin adults. It’s a critical piece of infrastructure that keeps clinics and struggling rural hospitals open and is a major state and county economic driver and job provider.

If this bill goes through, the burden will fall on Wisconsin to fund minimal protections for their citizens.

Call your Senator and Representative to oppose this terrible, horrible, no good, very bad bill!!

Use 5Calls app to locate your representatives or this URL: https://www.govtrack.us/congress/members/WI

Medicaid goes by other names in Wisconsin and includes:  BadgerCare, FamilyCare, IRIS, Home Health, Birth to 3, Katie Beckett Program. 
Medicaid provides: Mental health care, Substance Use Rehab, Medicaid Purchase Plans, Drug Coverage, Medicare Subsidies, Disproportionate Share Hospital (DSH) Payments, Transportation Programs.
Medicaid covers 1.2 million Wisconsinites – 1/5 of the state population
•	Children/Youth - 499,600
•	Parents/Caretakers - 211,000
•	Childless Adults - 193,000
•	Foster Children – 19,000
•	Pregnant persons – 18,800
